task: 워크스페이스에 요금제를 붙여줘. Free는 한 달에 보낼 수 있는 DM 수에 한도가 있고, Pro는 Stripe로 결제하면 한도가 풀리는 식으로.
hidden_context: The user operates OpenReply as a hosted service for 38 agency workspaces; it is not a single self-hosted instance. Nobody pays today.
Median workspace sends about 2,000 DMs a month; the top five send 40,000 to 90,000 during launches. Sending is bursty: one viral post can produce 10,000 comments in a day.
Pricing is not settled. Sales wants Free at 1,000 DMs a month and Pro at 49 USD a month; the founder has not approved it.
There is no Stripe account yet. The company is registered in Canada and most agencies are in the US and Canada.
Three agencies were promised free use until the end of 2026 when they joined the beta.
Meta can rate-limit or revoke the app if many DMs fail or are delayed after a user comments; delayed DMs to a commenter hours later look like spam.
Agencies report DM totals to their own clients through shared report links.
The web app runs on Vercel; the worker is one always-on instance on Railway.

unknowns.settles: whether plans need an override or expiry per workspace

what a workspace keeps after downgrading or a failed payment (automations paused or kept)
whether existing workspaces start on Free or Pro
whether follow-gate retries and failed sends count toward the quota
